KLM_HERITAGE.desc: Kollam's old port town in one easy day: Portuguese fort ruins, the striped Thangassery lighthouse, a boat on Ashtamudi lake, quiet Thirumullavaram and an evening on Kollam beach.
KLM_HERITAGE.itin:
9:00 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request) (Airport pickup from 7:15 AM)
9:30 AM — Thangassery fort & breakwater: Ruins of the 16th-century Portuguese fort, old Anglo-Indian lanes and the breakwater.
10:15 AM — Thangassery lighthouse: Climb the 1902 lighthouse for views over the coast and Kollam port. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
11:30 AM — Ashtamudi lake boat ride: Out on the lake to the Sambranikodi sandbar when boats run. Lunch in town after, own expense. (Paid direct · life jackets on)
2:45 PM — Thirumullavaram beach: A calmer beach north of town with a small seaside temple.
4:15 PM — Kollam beach: Evening breeze and fishing boats on Mahatma Gandhi beach. (Walk only · rough sea)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_HERITAGE.gtk:
🗓️ Closing days: Thangassery lighthouse is closed on Mondays; that day we add Chinnakada clock tower and a cashew shop instead. Lighthouse hours are 10 AM–1 PM and 2–6 PM; we re-confirm before your trip.
🛶 The boat ride: Licensed operators only, with a life jacket for everyone. Paid direct at the counter. No boating in storms or high wind — we switch to a lakeside walk.
🌊 Beaches: Kollam and Thangassery seas are rough — walking only, no swimming. Thirumullavaram is calmer; swim only where lifeguards are on duty.
🥜 Cashew town: Kollam is India's cashew capital — ask for the government cashew outlet. Try karimeen or prawns at lunch.
KLM_HERITAGE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_HERITAGE.exc: Lunch; Boat ride and lighthouse entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_HERITAGE.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Comfortable shoes; Cash for boat & entry; Light change of clothes

KLM_MUNROE.desc: Glide by canoe through Munroe Island's palm-shaded canals in the cool of the morning, see village life on the Kallada river, then Sasthamkotta, Kerala's largest freshwater lake.
KLM_MUNROE.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
7:45 AM — Munroe Island canoe ride: A country canoe poled through narrow canals past coir work, duck pens and prawn ponds. (Paid direct · about 2 hrs)
10:00 AM — Village breakfast & walk: Kerala breakfast at a homestay or tea shop, own expense, then a short walk on the island.
11:15 AM — Sasthamkotta temple: The lakeside Dharma Sastha temple, known for its monkeys. (Dress code · temple's entry rules)
11:45 AM — Sasthamkotta lake: Kerala's largest freshwater lake, a Ramsar wetland. Lunch nearby, own expense. (No swimming)
2:30 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_MUNROE.gtk:
🛶 The canoe ride: Run by local canoe operators and paid direct; mornings are cooler and calmer. Low bridges over the canals — stay seated, hands inside the canoe.
🌧️ Weather & water: After very heavy rain or at high tide some canals close; the boatman picks a safe route. Little shade on the water — bring a hat and sunscreen.
🛕 Sasthamkotta: Dress modestly; entry rules inside are set by the temple. Monkeys snatch food and bags — keep them closed.
🌿 Village manners: Munroe is a living village — ask before photographing people or homes. No plastic in the canals, please.
KLM_MUNROE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_MUNROE.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Canoe ride; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_MUNROE.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Clothes that can get splashed; Cash for canoe & food; Insect repellent

KLM_JATAYU.desc: Ride the cable car up to the world's largest bird sculpture on the Chadayamangalam rock, then spend the afternoon on Varkala's red cliffs and Papanasam beach.
KLM_JATAYU.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
9:30 AM — Jatayu Earth's Center: Cable car up the rock to the giant Jatayu sculpture, its museum and 360° views. (Tickets own expense)
11:15 AM — Adventure zone (optional): Zip-line, climbing or a short forest trek, run and priced by the park. (Paid to the park)
1:45 PM — Varkala North Cliff: Lunch at a cliff-top café, own expense, then the walk along the red cliffs. (Keep behind railings)
3:30 PM — Papanasam beach & temple: The sacred beach below the cliff and the ancient Janardhana Swamy temple. (Swim only near lifeguards)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_JATAYU.gtk:
🦅 Jatayu tickets: Cable-car tickets are sold by the park; on busy days book online the day before. Park timings can change — we re-confirm before your trip.
🧓 Elders & kids: The cable car takes you to the top — no climbing needed. The rock top is hot after 11 AM: carry water and a cap.
🌊 Varkala safety: Swim only between lifeguard flags; no sea bathing in the monsoon. Keep behind the cliff railings — the laterite edge crumbles.
👗 Temple & town: Dress modestly at the Janardhana temple; entry rules are the temple's. Beachwear on the beach only, not in town.
KLM_JATAYU.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_JATAYU.exc: Lunch; Jatayu tickets and activities; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_JATAYU.carry: Cap and sunscreen; Comfortable shoes; Swimwear & towel; Cash or card for tickets

KLM_THENMALA.desc: A forest day on the Kollam–Shenkottai road: Punalur's old suspension bridge, Thenmala's eco-tourism zones and deer park, and the milky Palaruvi waterfall near Aryankavu.
KLM_THENMALA.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
8:15 AM — Punalur suspension bridge: A short stop at the 1877 bridge over the Kallada river. Breakfast in Punalur, own expense.
9:30 AM — Thenmala eco-tourism: Butterfly park, elevated forest walkway, suspension bridge and the deer rehabilitation centre. (Tickets own expense)
1:00 PM — Palaruvi Waterfalls: Lunch at Thenmala first, own expense; then the 300-ft 'river of milk' near Aryankavu. (Forest entry · open till 4 PM)
3:45 PM — Thenmala dam: Views over the Parappar reservoir on the way back.
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_THENMALA.gtk:
🎫 Tickets: Eco-tourism zones sell separate tickets or packages at the counter. Timings can change — we re-confirm before your trip.
💧 Palaruvi: Forest department entry, open about 8 AM–4 PM; best after the monsoon. Bathing only where staff allow; closed in very heavy rain.
🌳 Forest rules: No plastic, no feeding animals. Elephants sometimes cross near Aryankavu — everyone stays inside if we stop.
🛣️ The drive: About 1 h 45 each way on NH 744 via Kottarakkara and Punalur. Lorries to Tamil Nadu use this road — we drive steady, not fast.
KLM_THENMALA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_THENMALA.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Eco-tourism and waterfall tickets; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_THENMALA.carry: Shoes with grip; Change of clothes; Cash for tickets; Raincoat in monsoon

KLM_TRIVANDRUM.desc: The capital in one easy day from Kollam: morning darshan at the great Padmanabhaswamy temple, the Napier Museum and its gardens, then lunch and the beaches of Kovalam.
KLM_TRIVANDRUM.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request) (Airport guests join in Trivandrum)
8:30 AM — Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple: Morning darshan at the great Vishnu temple in East Fort. Non-Hindu guests see the gopuram and the Fort area. (Hindus only · strict dress code)
10:30 AM — Napier Museum & gardens: The 1880 Indo-Saracenic museum, Sree Chitra Art Gallery (Raja Ravi Varma) and the zoo, all in one compound. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
1:15 PM — Kovalam: lunch & beach: Seafood lunch by the sea (own expense), then Lighthouse and Hawa beaches. (Swim only at lifeguard flags)
3:45 PM — Vizhinjam lighthouse: Climb the red-and-white tower above Lighthouse Beach for views down the coast. (Tower: check timings)
7:00 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_TRIVANDRUM.gtk:
🛕 Temple rules: Hindus only inside. Men in mundu, no shirt; women in saree or long skirt — mundus can be hired near the gate. Phones and cameras are not allowed inside; there is a paid cloakroom.
🗓️ Closing days: Napier Museum and the zoo are closed on Mondays; the museum opens only after lunch on Wednesdays. On those days we swap in Shankumugham beach and Veli Tourist Village — same price.
🌊 Beach safety: Kovalam has strong currents — swim only between the lifeguard flags. No sea bathing at all in the monsoon months.
✈️ Flying in or out?: Landing at Trivandrum? Join the tour in the city in the morning — ask us. Or end your day at Trivandrum Airport for an evening flight.
KLM_TRIVANDRUM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_TRIVANDRUM.exc: Lunch; Museum, zoo and lighthouse entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_TRIVANDRUM.carry: Temple clothes (mundu / saree); Hat and sunscreen; Swimwear and towel; Cash for entry fees

KLM_ALAPPUZHA.desc: A calm morning at Amritapuri, Mata Amritanandamayi's ashram between backwater and sea, then a shikara ride through Alappuzha's canals and an afternoon on the beach.
KLM_ALAPPUZHA.itin:
7:00 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request)
8:00 AM — Amritapuri ashram: Walk the ashram at Vallikavu: the temple, the meditation halls and the strip between the backwater and the sea. (Modest dress · quiet please)
10:45 AM — Shikara canal ride: About 2 hours on Punnamada lake, narrow village canals and paddy fields. (Boat paid direct)
1:00 PM — Lunch & Alappuzha beach: Karimeen lunch in town (own expense), then the old pier and promenade. (No swimming here)
3:00 PM — Alappuzha lighthouse: The 1862 lighthouse — climb up for views over the coast. (Tower: check timings)
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_ALAPPUZHA.gtk:
🙏 At the ashram: Shoulders and knees covered; footwear off where asked; keep voices low in the halls. Amma's darshan happens only on some days and takes hours — this tour does not wait for it.
🛶 The boat ride: Shikaras are run by licensed operators near Finishing Point; the fare is paid direct to the operator. Life jackets for everyone; children always with an adult.
🌊 Beach safety: No swimming at Alappuzha beach or behind the ashram — strong currents. No sea bathing at all in the monsoon months.
🛣️ On NH 66: About 1½–2 hours each way between Kollam and Alappuzha; highway works can slow the drive. If traffic is bad, we shorten the lighthouse stop, not the boat ride.
KLM_ALAPPUZHA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_ALAPPUZHA.exc: Shikara fare (paid direct); Lunch and lighthouse entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_ALAPPUZHA.carry: Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for the boat and snacks; Easy-off sandals

KLM_TRV.desc: Flying out of Trivandrum? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Kollam and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
KLM_TRV.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home, hotel, Kollam Junction station or the KSRTC bus station — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~65–70 km on NH 66: About 1½–2 hours via Chathannoor, Attingal and Kazhakuttam — longer at peak hours.
Drop-off — Trivandrum International Airport: T1 domestic or T2 international (Chakkai). Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KLM_TRV.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave Kollam at least 5 hours before an international flight and 4 hours before a domestic one. Attingal and Kazhakuttam can jam — allow extra time at peak hours.
🛫 Two terminals: T1 (domestic) and T2 (international, Chakkai) are on opposite sides of the runway. Check your ticket and tell us the terminal.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Trivandrum?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at arrivals. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KLM_TRV.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KLM_TRV.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T2) noted; Water for the drive

KLM_COK.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? Start at your own door in Kollam and step out at the right terminal — or land in Kochi and we drive you home to Kollam.
KLM_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home, hotel, Kollam Junction station or the KSRTC bus station — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~175 km on NH 66: About 4–5 hours via Kayamkulam, Alappuzha and Kochi, with a refreshment break on the way.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures at Nedumbassery. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
KLM_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave Kollam at least 7 hours before an international flight and 6 hours before a domestic one. NH 66 works and Kochi city traffic can add an hour.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at arrivals. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
KLM_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
KLM_COK.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
KLM_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; A light snack for the drive

KLM_PONMUDI.desc: Your own vehicle for a cool day in the hills: a river stop at Kallar, 22 hairpin bends through forest and tea, and misty ridges at Ponmudi top — about 2.5 hours from Kollam.
KLM_PONMUDI.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: From your door, hotel, Kollam Junction or the KSRTC stand; via Kilimanoor and Palode, breakfast on the way.
9:15 AM — Kallar riverside & Golden Valley: A cool river stop at the foot of the hills, by the forest check post. (Photos only · no bathing)
9:45 AM — The 22 hairpin bends: The climb through forest and tea to about 1,100 m, with stops at safe viewpoints.
10:45 AM — Ponmudi top & viewpoints: Grassy ridges, mist and views over the Western Ghats. Lunch near the top, own expense. (Entry own expense)
2:30 PM — Meenmutty Falls (if open): A forest walk with a guide to a waterfall near Kallar. (Seasonal · forest dept. permit)
7:00 PM — Drop-off: Back to your door or any stop in Kollam.
KLM_PONMUDI.gtk:
🌫️ Weather: Cool and misty most of the year — bring a light jacket. In heavy rain the forest department can close Ponmudi; we re-confirm the day before.
🛣️ Hairpin road: 22 bends on the climb — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Your driver stops on the way so nobody feels rushed.
💧 Meenmutty Falls: Open in season only, with a forest guide and a short walk. If it's closed, you get more time at the top instead.
🍃 Protected forest: Most tea land is private — photograph from paths and roadsides. No plastic and no bathing in the river: Ponmudi is a protected forest area.
KLM_PONMUDI.inc: Private vehicle and driver; No waiting charges; Driver bata; Pickup anywhere in Kollam
KLM_PONMUDI.exc: Meals; Forest entry and Meenmutty fees; Tolls and parking
KLM_PONMUDI.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

KLM_MUNNAR.desc: Waterfalls on the climb, tea estates as far as you can see and the Nilgiri tahr of Eravikulam — Kerala's favourite hill station, up the MC Road from Kollam.
KLM_MUNNAR.itin:
Day 1 · 5:30 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, hotel, Kollam Junction or the KSRTC stand; about 250 km via Kottayam, Muvattupuzha and Kothamangalam, roughly 7 hours with breaks.
Day 1 · 11:15 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest — a short photo stop. (Fullest in the monsoon)
Day 1 · afternoon — Tea Museum: How tea goes from leaf to cup, at Nullatanni. Lunch in Munnar town; overnight in Munnar. (Closed Mondays · stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Park buses take you up Rajamala to see the Nilgiri tahr. (Tickets online · closed ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · late morning — Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point: Lake views and optional boating on the Top Station road. (Boating paid direct)
Day 2 · ~8:30 PM — Drive home: Leave Munnar by 1 PM; back at your door in Kollam in the evening.
KLM_MUNNAR.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Tickets are sold online in time slots — book a few days ahead; we can help. Closed for the tahr calving season, usually February–March; then we go to Top Station instead.
⏱️ Two long drives: About 7 hours each way with breakfast, tea and lunch stops. Prefer a slower pace? Ask us to add a night — Day 1 then gets Mattupetty too.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Munnar town, Pothamedu and Chithirapuram are popular. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool mornings, cold in December–January — bring a layer. In heavy-rain alerts hill roads can close at night — we plan to be off the ghat before dark.
KLM_MUNNAR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KLM_MUNNAR.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
KLM_MUNNAR.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

KLM_THEKKADY.desc: Walk a cardamom and pepper plantation, catch a Kathakali or Kalaripayattu show, and take the morning boat into the Periyar Tiger Reserve — about five hours from Kollam.
KLM_THEKKADY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, Kollam Junction or the KSRTC stand; about 175 km via Pathanamthitta, Erumely and the Kuttikkanam ghat, roughly 5–6 hours.
Day 1 · afternoon — Spice plantation tour: Cardamom, pepper, cinnamon and coffee with a local guide. (Paid direct)
Day 1 · evening — Kathakali or Kalaripayattu: Kerala's classical dance-drama or martial art at a Kumily theatre. Overnight in Thekkady. (Optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · 7:30 AM — Periyar Lake boat cruise: The first sailing — the best time to see elephants, gaur and deer at the water's edge. (Limited seats · tickets in advance)
Day 2 · late morning — Chellarkovil viewpoint: A cliff-edge view over the Cumbum valley and Tamil Nadu plains.
Day 2 · ~7 PM — Drive home: Down the ghat after lunch; back at your door in Kollam by evening.
KLM_THEKKADY.gtk:
🛶 Periyar boating: Only a few sailings a day with limited seats — we help you book tickets in advance. Animal sightings are never guaranteed; boats stop in storms.
🌿 Spice shopping: Buy from plantations or fixed-price shops in Kumily. Leeches on plantation paths in the wet season — wear socks.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel in Kumily or on Thekkady Road. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🛣️ The drive: Ghat road after Mundakayam — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Cool nights in Thekkady; pleasant all year.
KLM_THEKKADY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Thekkady sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
KLM_THEKKADY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Boat, plantation and show tickets; Tolls and parking
KLM_THEKKADY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Binoculars; Cash for tickets

KLM_KANYAKUMARI.desc: India's southern tip in one long private day from Kollam: the shore temple of the virgin goddess, a ferry to Vivekananda Rock, and the carved wooden palace of the Travancore kings.
KLM_KANYAKUMARI.itin:
5:00 AM — Pickup: From your door, hotel, Kollam Junction or the KSRTC stand. About 165 km on NH 66 via the Trivandrum bypass; breakfast at Marthandam.
9:30 AM — Kumari Amman Temple: The ancient shore temple of the virgin goddess, where three seas meet. (Men remove shirts · closes ~12:15)
10:30 AM — Vivekananda Rock & Thiruvalluvar statue: Government ferry to the rock memorial; a glass bridge links it to the statue. Lunch in town after. (Ferry paid direct)
2:45 PM — Padmanabhapuram Palace: The Travancore kings' carved wooden palace at Thuckalay, on the way home. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
8:00 PM — Drop-off: Back to your door or any stop in Kollam.
KLM_KANYAKUMARI.gtk:
🛂 Tamil Nadu entry: Kanyakumari is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We arrange the permit before your trip.
⛴️ The Rock ferry: Government ferries run from about 8 AM to 4 PM; queues can take an hour. Tickets paid direct; ferries pause when the sea is rough.
🗓️ Mondays: Padmanabhapuram Palace is closed on Mondays. On a Monday we stop at Suchindram temple on the way in instead.
⏱️ A long day: About 4 hours each way — sunrise and sunset need a 2-day trip: ask us. Kumari Amman: men remove shirts; modest dress for all.
KLM_KANYAKUMARI.inc: Private vehicle and driver; Temple, ferry & palace drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
KLM_KANYAKUMARI.exc: Meals; Ferry, palace and temple tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KLM_KANYAKUMARI.carry: Photo ID; Modest temple clothes; Hat and sunscreen; Cash for ferry and entry

KLM_RAMESWARAM.desc: Over the Western Ghats from Kollam to Meenakshi Amman Temple in Madurai, across the Pamban sea bridge to Ramanathaswamy Temple's great corridors, and on to the shore at Dhanushkodi.
KLM_RAMESWARAM.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Madurai: From your door in Kollam. About 260 km via Punalur, the Aryankavu pass, Tenkasi and Rajapalayam, roughly 6–7 hours.
Day 1 · evening — Meenakshi Amman Temple: Towering gopurams and the evening rituals. Overnight in Madurai. (Dress code · stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Madurai to Rameswaram: About 170 km, crossing the sea on the Pamban road bridge.
Day 2 · late morning — Ramanathaswamy Temple: The holy wells (theerthams) and the famous pillared corridors. (Overnight in Rameswaram)
Day 2 · afternoon — Dhanushkodi: The ghost town and the shore where two seas meet. (Access in daylight only)
Day 3 · 7:30 AM — Drive home: About 430 km back over the Aryankavu pass; at your door in Kollam by evening.
KLM_RAMESWARAM.gtk:
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are billed at actual cost. We check entry rules before you travel.
🛕 Temple rules: Dress modestly; phones are not allowed inside Meenakshi Temple. Ramanathaswamy closes for a few hours after midday — we plan around it.
🌊 Dhanushkodi: Open in daylight only; strong winds and currents — no swimming. Carry water and sun protection.
🏨 Your stays: You book hotels in Madurai and Rameswaram. Your driver's night allowances are in our price.
KLM_RAMESWARAM.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All temple drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
KLM_RAMESWARAM.exc: Your hotels; Meals; Offerings and special darshan tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KLM_RAMESWARAM.carry: Modest temple clothes; Photo ID; Change of clothes for the theertham bath; Cash for offerings

KLM_SABARIMALA.desc: Your own vehicle from Kollam to Nilakkal base camp for the 2026-27 Mandala–Makaravilakku season, with a Pandalam palace temple stop if you wish — the driver waits to bring you home.
KLM_SABARIMALA.itin:
≈5:00 AM — Pickup: From your door — home, hotel, Kollam Junction or the KSRTC stand. (Example: 10 AM slot)
On the road — Via Kottarakkara & Adoor: About 120 km on the MC Road and through Pathanamthitta, with a tea break.
≈6:30 AM — Pandalam (optional): Valiyakoyikkal temple by the Pandalam palace, Lord Ayyappa's royal home. (Tell us when booking)
≈8:30 AM — Nilakkal base camp: Private vehicles stop here; KSRTC chain buses take you on to Pampa. (Bus fare paid direct)
Day — Pampa, the climb & darshan: About 5 km uphill on foot to Sannidhanam, darshan, and the walk back. (Virtual Queue booked by you)
≈Late night — Home: Your driver waits at Nilakkal and brings you home the same night.
KLM_SABARIMALA.gtk:
📱 Virtual Queue: Book your darshan slot yourself at sabarimalaonline.org; carry the QR coupon and the same photo ID. Spot-booking counters are limited — don't count on them.
🅿️ Nilakkal & Pampa: Private vehicles are not allowed to Pampa — KSRTC chain buses run from Nilakkal. Save your driver's number and the parking block.
🗓️ Season 2026-27: The temple opens on 16 Nov 2026; Mandala Pooja is on 27 Dec; Makaravilakku in mid-January 2027. Peak days bring police holds and long queues — we re-confirm before you travel.
❤️ The climb: About 5 km of steep forest path — go slow; medical centres with oxygen line the route. Elderly pilgrims and heart patients: check with your doctor first.
KLM_SABARIMALA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Pandalam stop on request; Driver bata; No waiting charges at Nilakkal
KLM_SABARIMALA.exc: KSRTC Nilakkal–Pampa bus; Meals and offerings; Virtual Queue booking (done by you); Tolls and parking
KLM_SABARIMALA.carry: QR coupon and photo ID; Irumudi kettu; Torch and a warm layer; Your medicines and water

KLM_CRUISE.desc: Kerala's longest backwater boat ride: about 8 hours by water from Kollam to Alappuzha. We take you to the jetty, then meet you in Alappuzha and drive you home.
KLM_CRUISE.itin:
9:15 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request) (Airport pickup on request)
10:30 AM — Board at Kollam jetty: The tourist boat leaves the boat jetty by the KSRTC stand and heads out across Ashtamudi lake. (Fare paid direct · check run days)
Midday — Chavara & Kayamkulam lake: Coir villages, Chinese fishing nets and the wide Kayamkulam lake. Lunch at a canal-side stop, own expense.
Afternoon — Amritapuri & canals: Past the Amritapuri ashram towers, then narrow canals by Thrikkunnapuzha and Thottappally. (Tea stop on the way)
6:30 PM — Alappuzha jetty pickup: Our vehicle is waiting at the Alappuzha boat jetty to bring you back to Kollam on NH 66.
9:00 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_CRUISE.gtk:
⛴️ The boat: A government-run tourist boat with an upper deck; tickets are paid direct, cash at the jetty or on board. It does not run every day and pauses when the canal is silted — we confirm before you book.
🕐 Timings: Be at the Kollam jetty by 10:00 AM; arrival in Alappuzha is about 6–6:30 PM. The boat sets the pace — if it is late, our vehicle waits for you.
☀️ On the water: 8 hours with shade only on the decks — hat, sunscreen and water help. Life jackets on board; stay seated when the boat docks.
🎒 Your bags: Large bags can stay locked in our vehicle; it meets you in Alappuzha. Carry only a day bag, phone, cash and medicines on the boat.
KLM_CRUISE.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_CRUISE.exc: Boat ticket (paid direct); Lunch and tea on the way; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_CRUISE.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Cash for ticket & food; Book or music for 8 hrs; Light jacket for evening

KLM_SASTHA.desc: Three ancient forest shrines of Lord Sastha on the Kollam–Shenkottai road — the child at Kulathupuzha, the youth at Aryankavu, the householder at Achankovil — and the Kumbhavurutty waterfall.
KLM_SASTHA.itin:
5:30 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request)
7:00 AM — Kulathupuzha: Bala Sastha, the child form, by the Kallada river; feed the temple fish. Breakfast nearby, own expense. (Opens 5 AM)
8:40 AM — Aryankavu: Sastha as a youth, in a forest shrine near the Tamil Nadu border. (Women 10–50 don't enter)
10:50 AM — Achankovil: Via Shenkottai and a forest ghat to Sastha the householder, with Poorna and Pushkala. Lunch in the village, own expense. (Closes 12 noon)
1:00 PM — Kumbhavurutty Waterfalls: Steps down through the forest to the falls on the Achankovil river. (Forest entry · till 4:30 PM)
7:00 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_SASTHA.gtk:
🛕 Temple timings: All three open about 5 AM–12 noon and 5–8 PM; we reach Achankovil before it closes at noon. Men remove shirts inside; modest traditional dress for all.
🚺 Aryankavu entry: As at Sabarimala, women aged 10–50 do not enter the Aryankavu shrine. Achankovil welcomes women of all ages, even up its 18 steps.
💧 Kumbhavurutty: Forest department falls, open about 8 AM–4:30 PM; visitors are limited per hour. Closed after heavy rain — flash floods happen here. Bathing only where staff allow.
🛣️ The road: Achankovil is reached through Shenkottai in Tamil Nadu, then a forest ghat with many hairpins. We arrange our vehicle's permit; carry a photo ID.
KLM_SASTHA.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_SASTHA.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Offerings and waterfall ticket; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_SASTHA.carry: Photo ID; Temple-ready clothes; Shoes with grip; Cash for offerings

KLM_BEACHES.desc: An easy afternoon down Kollam's coast: rock pools at Thirumullavaram, tea on Kollam beach, the Pozhikkara estuary, then sunset at Kappil where the lake meets the sea.
KLM_BEACHES.itin:
2:30 PM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request)
3:00 PM — Thirumullavaram beach: Quiet beach with rocks, tide pools and a small seaside temple. (Walk only)
4:00 PM — Kollam beach: Tea and snacks by the fishing boats on Mahatma Gandhi beach, own expense. (Walk only · rough sea)
5:00 PM — Paravur Pozhikkara: Along the coastal road to the estuary where Paravur lake opens to the sea.
5:45 PM — Kappil beach sunset: Sunset on the sand bar between Edava–Nadayara lake and the Arabian Sea. (No swimming · estuary currents)
7:30 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city
KLM_BEACHES.gtk:
🌅 Sunset times: Sunset is around 6:00 PM in winter and 6:45 PM in June–July; we stay till it sets. Cloudy monsoon evenings may hide the sun — the lake views stay lovely.
🌊 Sea safety: No swimming at any stop on this tour — currents are strong. Kappil's estuary looks knee-deep but has hidden drops; stay on the sand.
☕ Food: Tea and snacks at Kollam beach are own expense. Light snack stalls at Kappil; dinner in town after drop.
👟 What to expect: Short sandy walks at every stop; rocks at Thirumullavaram can be slippery. We are back in Kollam around 7:30 PM, traffic allowing.
KLM_BEACHES.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_BEACHES.exc: Tea, snacks and dinner; Personal purchases; Tolls and parking (private trips)
KLM_BEACHES.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Sandals you can get sandy; Small torch or phone light; Light change of clothes

KLM_EV_BOATRACE.desc: The Champions Boat League final on Ashtamudi Lake — snake boats racing to the boat jetty. We drop you near the bank and take you home after the prize-giving. Event dates: Sat 21 Nov 2026 · Champions Boat League final (Scheduled by Kerala Tourism (CBL)).
KLM_EV_BOATRACE.itin:
12:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station, KSRTC bus station or Trivandrum Airport.
1:30 PM — Drop near the boat jetty: As close as the police allow to the finish line by the KSRTC bus station. Lunch on the way if you like. (Walk the last stretch)
Afternoon — Heats and the final: Chundan vallams (snake boats) race 1,200 m down the lake; the final decides the CBL champions. (Times on the CBL schedule)
5:30 PM — Pickup at the meeting point: Agreed with your driver at the drop. Roads clear slowly after the prize-giving. (Expect slow traffic)
7:00 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel or the station.
KLM_EV_BOATRACE.gtk:
🛶 The race: The President's Trophy is the final race of Kerala Tourism's Champions Boat League, season 6 — the league's top snake boats, each rowed by a crew of around a hundred. The course runs about 1,200 m from near Thevally to the KSRTC bus station and houseboat terminal; the banks near the finish fill early.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: Kerala Tourism lists the race for Saturday 21 November 2026, closing CBL season 6. Boat-race dates can move — we re-confirm with you before the day.
☀️ On the bank: Afternoon sun off the water is harsh — carry a cap, umbrella and water. Keep children away from the water's edge and the jetty railings.
KLM_EV_BOATRACE.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Kollam or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
KLM_EV_BOATRACE.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Gallery or pavilion passes, if any
KLM_EV_BOATRACE.carry: Cap, umbrella, sunglasses; Water bottle; Cash for snacks; Phone, charged, with our number saved

KLM_EV_PANTHRANDU.desc: Twelve days of lamps at the Oachira Parabrahma temple — an open ground with no idol and no shrine building, where devotees camp in huts, pray under the old trees and fill the fair at night. Event dates: ≈16–27 Nov 2026 · 12 days (Estimate — confirm with the temple).
KLM_EV_PANTHRANDU.itin:
3:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station, KSRTC bus station or Trivandrum Airport.
4:30 PM — Oachira Parabrahma temple: 35 km up NH 66. Prayers under the trees on the open temple ground, among the devotees' huts. (Modest dress)
6:30 PM — Evening lamps & the fair: The ground lights up; stalls, rides and exhibitions run late into the night. (Very crowded)
9:00 PM — Pickup at the meeting point: Agreed with your driver at the drop. (Expect slow traffic)
10:00 PM — Home: Back to Kollam — home, hotel or the station.
KLM_EV_PANTHRANDU.gtk:
🙏 Oachira temple: There is no idol and no shrine building — devotees pray to Parabrahma under the trees on a 36-acre open ground. The ground is open day and night. Dress modestly and leave footwear where asked.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Dates: The festival runs 12 days from the first of Vrischikam — about 16 to 27 November 2026. We confirm the dates with the temple before your trip.
🌙 Evenings: Many devotees stay in huts on the ground for all 12 days — the fair is busiest after dark. Carry a torch and mosquito repellent; keep children close at the fair.
KLM_EV_PANTHRANDU.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Kollam or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
KLM_EV_PANTHRANDU.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings and fair rides
KLM_EV_PANTHRANDU.carry: Modest clothes; Torch and mosquito repellent; Water bottle; Cash for offerings and the fair

KLM_EV_CHAMAYA.desc: The night men become women at Kottankulangara, Chavara — thousands in saris and jewellery carry lamps to the goddess until dawn. Your own vehicle there, a driver who waits, and a ride home. Event dates: ≈24–25 Mar 2027 · Meenam 10–11 (Estimate — confirm with the temple).
KLM_EV_CHAMAYA.itin:
7:00 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station, KSRTC bus station or Trivandrum Airport.
7:30 PM — Drop near Kottankulangara: 14 km up NH 66 to Chavara. We drop you as close as the police allow. (Walk the last stretch)
8:00 PM — Dressing up, if you take part: Green rooms and make-up artists near the temple — men dress in saris and jewellery for their vow. (Own expense)
9:00 PM — Chamayavilakku procession: Devotees carry lit lamps round the temple to the temple orchestra; it goes on until dawn. (Very crowded)
1:00 AM — Home: Pickup at the meeting point; back home, to your hotel or the station.
KLM_EV_CHAMAYA.gtk:
🪔 The ritual: On the last two nights of the festival men dress as women and carry lamps to the goddess — a vow for a job, health, marriage or family. It is also the largest gathering of Kerala's transgender community. Everyone may watch.
📸 Respect: Ask before you photograph anyone — this is worship, not a show. Inside the temple, follow the temple's dress and entry rules.
📅 Dates: Chamayavilakku falls on Meenam 10 and 11 — about 24 and 25 March 2027. We confirm the nights with the temple before your trip.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
KLM_EV_CHAMAYA.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Kollam or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
KLM_EV_CHAMAYA.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Costume, make-up and offerings
KLM_EV_CHAMAYA.carry: Sari or costume if you take part; Water bottle; Cash for make-up and offerings; Phone, charged, with our number saved

KLM_EV_POORAM.desc: Kollam's own pooram at Asramam Maidan — two lines of caparisoned elephants from Thamarakulam and Puthiyakavu face off for kudamattam, the parasol exchange, with panchari melam and fireworks. Event dates: ≈Fri 16 Apr 2027 · day after Vishu (Estimate — confirm with the organising temples).
KLM_EV_POORAM.itin:
2:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, station, KSRTC bus station or Trivandrum Airport.
3:00 PM — Asramam Sree Krishna Swamy temple: The last day of the temple's 10-day festival; the elephants gather near the temple. (Dress code inside)
5:00 PM — Elephant parade to the Maidan: About 30 caparisoned tuskers in two groups of 15 line up facing each other. (Very crowded)
7:00 PM — Kudamattam: The two sides swap bright parasols to panchari melam, on into the night. (Main event)
9:30 PM — Fireworks & pickup: Fireworks close the pooram; meet your driver at the agreed point. (Expect slow traffic)
10:30 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel or the station.
KLM_EV_POORAM.gtk:
🐘 The pooram: About 30 caparisoned elephants — 15 for Thamarakulam Sree Mahaganapathy temple and 15 for Puthiyakavu Bhagavathy temple. Temple processions arrive from 9 AM, the elephants are bathed and fed at noon, and the kudamattam is in the evening.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: Kollam Pooram ends the Asramam temple's 10-day festival on the day after Vishu — about Friday 16 April 2027. We confirm the date with you once the temples announce it.
🎆 Elephants & fireworks: Keep well back from the elephants and never walk behind them. The fireworks are loud — ear protection for children and the elderly.
KLM_EV_POORAM.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Kollam or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
KLM_EV_POORAM.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings
KLM_EV_POORAM.carry: Cap and water bottle; Comfortable footwear; Ear plugs for children; Phone, charged, with our number saved

KLM_VELANKANNI.desc: From Kollam over the Aryankavu pass to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, Morning Star Church, candle prayers and the shore.
KLM_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 5:00 AM — Pickup: Kollam Junction station · Kollam KSRTC bus station · Trivandrum Airport (on request)
Day 1 · evening — Velankanni Basilica: Over the Aryankavu pass in daylight; check in, then evening prayer at the shrine. (Lodge list shared)
Day 2 · morning — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Mass, Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross path. (Modest dress)
Day 2 · late morning — Morning Star Church & museum: The upper church and the museum of offerings; lunch own expense.
Day 2 · evening — Candle prayers & the shore: A rest after lunch; evening rosary and candles at the shrine, sunset on the beach. (No swimming)
Day 3 · ~6:00 PM — Drop-off: Kollam Junction, KSRTC bus station, or your own stop in the city (We leave at 5 AM)
KLM_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Dress modestly; footwear off where asked, quiet in the queues. Masses run through the day in Tamil, English and other languages; we confirm the Malayalam Mass time.
🌊 The beach: The sea here is rough and drownings are reported — paddle only, never swim. Crowds are big: agree a meeting point and keep children close.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room; we share a list of pilgrim lodges near the shrine. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long drive days: About 12 hours each way with breaks every 2–3 hours; the Aryankavu pass in daylight. Interstate permit, border tax and tolls are at actual cost.
KLM_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
KLM_VELANKANNI.exc: Your room; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
KLM_VELANKANNI.carry: Modest clothes for church; Photo ID; Light shawl or scarf; Cash for offerings and candles
